Finance Officer Job at First Ally Capital




        
    

        
        First Ally Capital is a wholly indigenous Financial Services firm, whose focus is on providing top notch advisory & investment services to individuals and organizations. First Ally Capital was incorporated on May 20, 2014 as an Issuing House, Financial Advisory and Investment Management firm, with authorized capital of N2.5 billion, and an issued and fully-paid capital of N1.65 billion. The firm was licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 20, 2014 as Issuing House and Underwriters.
     

            
    



The Firm commenced operations at a very significant point in the evolution of the Nigerian financial services industry and will leverage it’s solid capital base, the strong financial services background of its promoters and the excellent track-record and credentials of its directors and shareholders.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Finance Officer to support financial reporting, budgeting, reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and other finance operations.
	We are looking for a highly motivated professional who is passionate about excellence, possesses strong technical and accounting expertise, and can leverage sound analytical and numerical skills to drive accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency within a dynamic banking environment.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related discipline.
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in finance or accounting.
	Professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, or equivalent is an advantage.
	Strong knowledge of financial reporting and reconciliations.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.

Sales & Marketing Executive Job at Leovio Concepts




        
    

        
        Leovio Concepts is an energy support company based in Lagos, Nigeria, delivering high-quality diesel supply to businesses reliant on generator-powered operations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales & Marketing Executive

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a Marketing Executive to develop sales and marketing strategies in our organization.
	The role of the sales and marketing executive is to drive sales by designing and implementing targeted marketing strategies.
	And also be responsible for tracking sales data and creating performance reports.


Key Responsibilities


	Maintaining client relations
	Support lead generation campaigns and promotional activities
	Available for outdoor marketing and meetings with client(s)
	Answering client queries about product specification and uses
	Tracking sales data to ensure the company meets sales quotas
	Creating and presenting a sales performance report
	Contributing to the development and marketing strategies
	Market research and client budget management
	Recommend improvements based on marketing insights and analytics.


Requirements
Technical Skills:


	Proven work experience as a marketing executive
	Familiar with digital marketing tools and platforms
	Proficient in MS Office, Google Suite
	High-level communication and project management skills.


Added advantage:


	Strong skills in Meta Ads Manager, Canva, and Social Media (Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.).


Salary
Range N120,000 to N200,000.00 monthly based on experience.

  "title": "Customer Service Officer",
  "description": "Party Supplies and More is Nigeria&#39;s premier party supplies store, offering everything needed to make celebrations special. We provide high-quality decorations, balloons, and party essentials with exceptional customer service. Our values center on excellence, reliability, and innovation, ensuring every customer leaves happy and every event becomes unforgettable.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
Job Position: Customer Service Officer

Job Location: Ojodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We&rsquo;re looking for a proactive Customer Care Representative with at least 1 year of recent experience.
	Must be social media-savvy, skilled in CRM tools, and live within or around Ojodudue to the on-site nature of the role.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond to customer queries via phone, email, and chat
	Resolve issues quickly and professionally
	Log interactions using CRM system
	Follow up on unresolved cases
	Work with internal teams to improve service delivery
	Takes and fulfills customers orders.


Requirements


	OND / HND / Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree
	1+ year of recent customer service experience
	Proficiency with CRM tools
	Strong communication skills
	Lives in or near Ojodu (mandatory)
	Creative, pays attention to details and a fast learner.


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 monthly.
